char_440_pinecn/cn_018: I guess it's like being a foreman at a construction site?
char_440_pinecn/cn_019: Um... Where are we going again...?
char_440_pinecn/cn_020: It's the enemy! Don't hold back!
char_440_pinecn/cn_024: I'll stay right here like a nail.
char_440_pinecn/cn_026: I still have lots of batteries on me!
char_440_pinecn/cn_028: Just like shooting nails at work!
char_440_pinecn/cn_029: Phew... That was a lot harder than building a house. Doctor, it makes us kinda impressive, don't you think?
char_440_pinecn/cn_030: That was perfect... Doctor, are you happy with how we did?
char_440_pinecn/cn_031: Hmm... Maybe I messed up the process...? I'm sorry. It didn't go as well as I'd hoped.
char_440_pinecn/cn_032: Eh? Why are there sparks... S-Sorry... It's all my fault...
char_446_aroma/cn_011: Hello, Doctor. I'm Logistics Operator Aroma. Would you open your hands like this? Don't worry... I just thought that with how nice and bright the sun is today, it would be perfect to put a bubble reflecting a rainbow onto your palm.
char_446_aroma/cn_017: How convenient. I want to test out my new bubbling formula.
char_446_aroma/cn_018: Remember to cover your noses. The aroma this time might be a little intense. Don't let the smell get you sneezing.
char_446_aroma/cn_019: I put a sign here— Wet floor. Be extra careful.
char_446_aroma/cn_020: The smell here reminds me of something really scary.
char_446_aroma/cn_023: These bubbles won't burst so easily.
char_446_aroma/cn_024: Remember to give your honest feedback on our products.
char_446_aroma/cn_029: Hm... smells a lot more refreshing now.
char_446_aroma/cn_030: I like this new ingredient. It's effective, and it doesn't harm your skin.
char_446_aroma/cn_031: Looks like we'll need a stronger stain removing formula next time.
char_450_necras/cn_011: Allowing me on board at last? Then, hand me the register. 'Necrass'—how about this codename, Erudite? Hm? Rhodes Island requires I go by a codename, so I've decided to fashion an appropriate one for you as well.
char_450_necras/cn_017: Do you require me to conceal my face? No? A judicious judgment. The dead shall remember, while the living will forget.
char_450_necras/cn_018: Your operators might fail to keep up with my harsh demands.
char_450_necras/cn_019: Let us be off, to create many more corpses.
char_450_necras/cn_020: Mortals grieve over death, but death has never mourned.
char_450_necras/cn_025: A touch of my finger shall crumble your wills.
char_450_necras/cn_026: Life withers and dissipates, remnants left to hesitate.
char_450_necras/cn_027: Bathed in fire, departed souls dance in a frenzy of fear.
char_450_necras/cn_028: The clamor of the dead peters out into oblivion.
char_450_necras/cn_029: You and your tactics are equally lethal, Erudite.
char_450_necras/cn_030: Why repress yourself? I see a desire for destruction in you, and you should let it all out... with no reservations.
char_450_necras/cn_031: Life is inherently flawed, so let's not grieve too much over it.
char_450_necras/cn_032: Should I take them all away? Good, you need only pay a tiny price... I'm sure you can afford it.
char_469_indigo/cn_011: Hello, Doctor. My name is Aria… Uh, sorry, I mean Indigo. I used to be a lighthouse keeper... Um, apprentice. Now my position is a Caster, but... also an apprentice. I really look forward to learning from you.
char_469_indigo/cn_018: Very well... I'll keep this light up. Please be careful not to wander off.
char_469_indigo/cn_020: If you insist on stopping us, then we have no choice but to defeat all of you.
char_469_indigo/cn_025: These enemies do not compare to the seas' ferocity.
char_469_indigo/cn_026: I shall stand guard, until daybreak.
char_469_indigo/cn_027: The fear for light, comes only from the evil within.
char_469_indigo/cn_028: If you wish to flee, then follow this light.
char_469_indigo/cn_029: With such power, perhaps we won't need to fear the arrival of that day…?
char_469_indigo/cn_030: Thank goodness. Another night of calm sea.
char_469_indigo/cn_031: S-Some enemies got away? I see. We must alert everyone.
char_469_indigo/cn_032: Doctor, this way... Don't be afraid. It doesn't matter how dark the path up ahead is, I'll light it for you.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_011: Have I turned the pages of destinies past? No, it is but a dream you avoid. My future.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_017: Why do you not seek more companions? It will make things easier. In time, you will understand. And much more than once, I regret to say.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_018: Elliot would have asked me: How does an empty soul lead others with sincerity?
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_019: I recall the weight on my back as I carried my grievously injured teacher—it was the weight of my war. Most wars are waged for profit; mine is born from vengeance.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_020: I fought for a single purpose. Let war be the past, then, if the purpose is lost.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_022: Do you remember the touch of quicksand?
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_023: My war machine will fulfill your wishes.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_024: After all, 'Man' is the ultimate weapon.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_025: I remember how each piece of equipment was born.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_026: What is there to be gained... by fighting in the name of my teacher?
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_029: There is no snow in the winters of the black market. Will I still see snow? Yes, but in that world of silvery white, nothing you know will remain.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_030: Your machinations will claim all. Is this how you became the master of the black market? Yes, as will you, Elliot. I know that well. You will not let anyone escape.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_031: Did you see how the punished fled? Yes, I did. I wonder if that was how those Columbians saw me.
char_472_pasngr_epoque#17/cn_032: The days to permit mistakes are gone for good, never to return. We are fighting an enemy too powerful. Fate? No, ourselves.
char_472_pasngr/cn_011: Your Operator, Passenger. I have long wished to work alongside you, Doctor. I'm sure we will both find this journey most enjoyable.
char_472_pasngr/cn_017: Allow me to demonstrate how a truly exceptional weapon of war operates.
char_472_pasngr/cn_018: I am quite familiar with strategy and planning. Of course, should you have other ideas, I defer to you.
char_472_pasngr/cn_020: Now then, we have everything in place.
char_472_pasngr/cn_029: You must pardon me; it seems my lowly weapons have barely served to accomplish this mission. Should you assent to my adopting more... extreme methods, we may thus have an easier time.
char_472_pasngr/cn_030: Thunder and lightning are but a form of punishment. They have paid the price for their ill deeds. How good it is, do you not think?
char_472_pasngr/cn_031: I cannot permit the punished to leave my sight in peace. Doctor, I plead you permit me to perform this aftercare.
char_472_pasngr/cn_032: A rather harsh defeat. But worry not, Doctor. Those who have snatched victory from your hands... will be privileged to experience suffering in full.
char_474_glady/cn_011: Dr. {@nickname}. I am Gladiia, the officer in charge of Rhodes Island's Ægir affairs. We will have many opportunities to collaborate in the future, but please see me as an outsider. I am not worthy of your trust yet.
char_474_glady/cn_017: I'll join this training as your squadron's aide.
char_474_glady/cn_018: This seems to be a low-intensity battle. Allow me to use it as hunting practice for your operators.
char_474_glady/cn_019: You are slow like you're caught in an undertow. I will slow down and wait, try to catch up.
char_474_glady/cn_020: Considering the level of this battle, allow me to save my strength.
char_474_glady/cn_025: Watch out. The currents will pull the weak into the abyss.
char_474_glady/cn_026: Have I granted you the permission to run away, my prey?
char_474_glady/cn_027: Just a second, then this lance will pierce your heart.
char_474_glady/cn_029: Survive. That's the only rule you must follow.
char_474_glady/cn_030: An archetypical victory. One day, you will be able to defeat all feeble creatures that come your way.
char_474_glady/cn_031: Better hope that the fleeing prey won't share information, so you still have a chance to savor the rest of your life at ease.
char_479_sleach/cn_011: You must be Rhodes Island's commander? Operator Saileach, reporting in!
char_479_sleach/cn_017: May my banner protect all those who are innocent before my eyes.
char_479_sleach/cn_018: My friends, as long as we stand together, there will be no evil we can't overcome!
char_479_sleach/cn_020: If battle is unavoidable, I will not allow my weaknesses to get in my way.
char_479_sleach/cn_023: It's my duty to stand here.
char_479_sleach/cn_025: Can't you hear the children's cries?
char_479_sleach/cn_026: Can't you feel the cities crumbling away?
char_479_sleach/cn_027: You've never ever noticed the hideous grins of conspirators.
char_479_sleach/cn_028: Could you ever imagine… friends turning against each other, and homeland fading into nothing but memories?
char_479_sleach/cn_029: I simply want to defend the people's right to live, and it doesn't matter if they are Victorians or Infected.
char_479_sleach/cn_030: You showed me that even weeds struggling to grow in the ruins can stand tall. Thank you.
char_479_sleach/cn_031: I can only hope they will come to understand their injustice.
char_479_sleach/cn_032: Doctor, this time, I'll stay. Hurry and take the others to safety.
char_485_pallas/cn_011: I am the Minoan priestess, Pallas. I shall be convalescing at Rhodes Island for a time... Be that as it may, I hope to enjoy my share of alcohol and theatre, and I yearn even more for battle.
char_485_pallas/cn_017: O heroic heralds of victory, I welcome your blessings.
char_485_pallas/cn_018: O great warriors, I fight by your side, shoulder to shoulder.
char_485_pallas/cn_019: The next time you turn your head, you will find us returning, with victory in hand.
char_485_pallas/cn_020: Fear not, for we shall claim victory over these reckless foes.
char_485_pallas/cn_023: There is no room for regret.
char_485_pallas/cn_024: There is no need to retreat.
char_485_pallas/cn_025: O heroes, stand together with us, for the paramount power of faith!
char_485_pallas/cn_026: Tremble, in the face of ture bravey.
char_485_pallas/cn_027: Weep, for that wavering faith of yours.
char_485_pallas/cn_029: Have we done it...? I feel only the greatest honor and joy.
char_485_pallas/cn_030: Turn about, brave champions. We have achieved a perfect victory, and it is now time to return and enjoy the fruits of our labors.
char_485_pallas/cn_031: Listen well, the lamentations have ceased. This calm heralds the arrival of peace and joy.
char_485_pallas/cn_032: Even though the wars of humanity have no end in sight, we have protected our dignity, for the moment. Leave. Keep your heads held high.
char_491_humus/cn_011: Doctor, Rhodes Island has done so much for me. What can I say except thank you? If you need anything, just say the word. I'll do whatever it takes to make it happen!
char_491_humus/cn_017: Agh... It's been a while since I beat anyone up. Hope I didn't get too rusty.
char_491_humus/cn_018: Yeah, I can be the captain and chaperone these kids. I'll make sure all of them come back alive.
char_491_humus/cn_019: Stop right there, you little cubs! Don't just rush in ahead!
char_491_humus/cn_020: You come at me like that, you can't blame me for what happens next.
char_491_humus/cn_023: Huh? I thought you wanted me here to fix a lock!
char_491_humus/cn_024: Whose car is this? I... How should I know?
char_491_humus/cn_026: What, you think you're gonna grind me down with numbers?
char_491_humus/cn_027: There's more of you? Ugh, what a day.
char_491_humus/cn_028: Arghhhh screw it! Bring it on, all of you!
char_491_humus/cn_029: Ugh, I just hope these punks learned their lesson.
char_491_humus/cn_030: No enemies in sight. But I'm sure they left behind some pretty good stuff.
char_491_humus/cn_031: No, no, don't chase them. Just let them be. They got beaten so bad, they won't be causing trouble for a long while.
char_491_humus/cn_032: Relax, nobody wins every fight. Go home, wash your face. Life goes on.
char_494_vendla/cn_011: Greetings, Doctor. Vendela reporting in. Um, what did Rockrock write for me next, I can't remember... Never mind! Please take this flower, I insist! Its meaning is good luck.
char_494_vendla/cn_017: I'll try my best to help everyone out.
char_494_vendla/cn_018: Everyone, please follow where the petals flutter.
char_494_vendla/cn_019: Don't be afraid of the thorns. They are here to help us.
char_494_vendla/cn_020: I won't allow them to trample apart this land!
char_494_vendla/cn_021: Ugh, there's a bad scent in the air.
char_494_vendla/cn_022: Will it really be possible to plant seeds here?
char_494_vendla/cn_023: I like these high places. They have plenty of sunshine.
char_494_vendla/cn_024: I heard someone tried planting sunflowers on the roof? Not a bad idea.
char_494_vendla/cn_027: Pay attention to where the petals fall.
char_494_vendla/cn_029: Do you see the dew shimmering on the petals? Such splendid scenery in the morning light… We wouldn't be enjoying this if not for you.
char_494_vendla/cn_030: Scything, uprooting... It sounds cruel. But if we want to deal with the weeds competing for nutrients, then I think there's no other way, Doctor.
char_494_vendla/cn_031: While on the front lines, I caught a glimpse of an unforgettable field of flowers, blooming with vigor and vitality. I was always curious where their nutrients came from. Now, I think I know…
char_496_wildmn/cn_011: Wild Mane' Iwona, I'm a Knight from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Sona says this place does good by the Infected? Sounds cool.
char_496_wildmn/cn_017: Who's got the guts to spar with me?
char_496_wildmn/cn_018: Phalanx formation suits me most. If I'm the captain, then let's go with my kind of tactics!
char_496_wildmn/cn_023: You guys think you're worth my full strength?
char_496_wildmn/cn_024: Don't you dare go down in one!
char_496_wildmn/cn_029: Keep on winning, and you'll never be forgotten. It's that simple.
char_496_wildmn/cn_030: Cheers, Doctor. You're a solid commander.
char_496_wildmn/cn_031: My Major Lance... *sigh* Gotta get repairs again.
char_496_wildmn/cn_032: Leave any regrets for later! Go, I'll cover the rear!
char_498_inside/cn_011: Liaison from the Lateran Notarial Hall, Insider. Here's the paperwork for our collaboration. May I ask which office I should be heading to next? I'm making my first impression here at Rhodes Island, so I want to do this perfectly.
char_498_inside/cn_017: Got it. You've determined that use of force is required in the current situation, and I'll trust you on that.
char_498_inside/cn_018: I'm in charge? Alright then, I would like everyone to act freely as they wish. And everyone is responsible for their own actions.
char_498_inside/cn_020: I wish everyone could just calm down, before I raise my gun to settle things.
char_498_inside/cn_022: Bullets may be fast, but they aren't always so quick to solve disputes.
char_498_inside/cn_023: Chill, everyone, I'm just here for a few questions.
char_498_inside/cn_024: If you insist on being so stubborn, then... prepare for execution.
char_498_inside/cn_025: I'm actually better at wrestling than shooting. Makes the cleanup easier.
char_498_inside/cn_026: I'll give you some time to cry out in pain while I adjust my weapon.
char_498_inside/cn_027: I was really hoping it wouldn't turn out like this.
char_498_inside/cn_028: In our current situation... A complete sweep would be the most efficient solution.
char_498_inside/cn_029: I knew I was getting into trouble coming here, but thankfully I've got you, Doctor. I wouldn't have figured out how to resolve such a complicated conflict by myself.
char_498_inside/cn_030: Alright, time to pack up my gun. Mission complete, Doctor. We achieved victory just as planned, so there shouldn't be any post mortem work required, right?
char_498_inside/cn_031: What, did some of them escape? Ah, I had one eye closed while aiming my shots, so maybe they happened to be out of my sight.
char_498_inside/cn_032: It's clear we need to overhaul our plans.
